positions.name: ZypherionAdoptionDecision
positions.frame: what database technology decision is being adopted, on what performance basis, and on what timeline?
positions.why: All six expressions cohere under a single directional read: the decision to adopt Zypherion Analytics for the analytics pipeline, the 15x columnar query performance improvement that justifies it, and the Q3 2026 migration timeline. The narrative statements (src-1, src-2, src-3) and their bullet-summary restatements (src-4, src-5, src-6) carry the same content under different footing — the frame holds both forms as one decisional arc.
